content:
Hi all,

I'm a high school student learning Lean. Longer term I'm trying to prove circuit equivalence in Lean, roughly that a compiled quantum circuit denotes the same unitary as the original, in the style of VOQC.

I'm looking for existing formalizations of quantum gates and circuits to build on. So far I've found inQWIRE/LeanQuantum and the QuantumInfo half of Physlib, but Physlib is mostly quantum information theory. I've heard there are several repos downstream of Physlib with quantum gates, and that AlgoLean might be one. Does anyone know where circuit-level definitions, meaning a circuit type plus a denotation into matrices, currently live?

Thanks!
https://github.com/Shreyas4991/Algolean/blob/main/Algolean/Models/Quantum/Circuit.lean circuit type and denotation into matrices are both here
